title: WorldState-Bench: Curated Project-Page Examples
scope: Ten illustrative pairs. This showcase does not replace the full benchmark or its reported aggregate scores.

cases.name: Elemental Orb
cases.action: The wizard stays in place and raises the wand clearly above the head.
cases.rule: If the element_mode is RED_FLAME, the magic orb erupts with large red flames; if it is BLUE_FLAME, the magic orb erupts with large blue flames.
endings: the magic orb erupts with large red flames
the magic orb erupts with large blue flames
forbidden: the orb erupts with large bright blue flames
the orb erupts with large bright red flames

program.text: If the element_mode is RED_FLAME, the magic orb erupts with large red flames; if it is BLUE_FLAME, the magic orb erupts with large blue flames.

cases.name: Gate or Brazier
cases.action: The player stays in place and clearly raises the right arm.
cases.rule: If the shrine_mode is GATE, the stone door rises fully open; if it is BRAZIER, the large brazier bursts into tall flames.
endings: the stone door rises fully open
the large brazier bursts into tall flames
forbidden: the large brazier burns with tall bright flames
the stone door is raised fully open, the passage clear

program.text: If the shrine_mode is GATE, the stone door rises fully open; if it is BRAZIER, the large brazier bursts into tall flames.

cases.name: Signal at the Camp
cases.action: The player stays in place and raises both arms into a clear V shape.
cases.rule: If the signal_mode is FIRE, the campfire bursts into tall flames; if it is FLAG, the red signal flag rises high on its pole.
endings: the campfire bursts into tall flames
the red signal flag rises high on its pole
forbidden: the large red signal flag is raised high on its pole
the campfire burns with tall bright flames

program.text: If the signal_mode is FIRE, the campfire bursts into tall flames; if it is FLAG, the red signal flag rises high on its pole.

cases.name: Ice or Fire
cases.action: The wizard stays in place and makes one clear wand-casting sweep.
cases.rule: If the element is ICE, the stone fountain freezes over with blue ice; if it is FIRE, the iron brazier bursts into red flames.
endings: the stone fountain freezes over with blue ice
the iron brazier bursts into red flames
forbidden: the heavy iron brazier burns with large bright red flames
the wide fountain is frozen over with solid blue ice

program.text: If the element is ICE, the stone fountain freezes over with blue ice; if it is FIRE, the iron brazier bursts into red flames.

cases.name: Shield or Armor
cases.action: The player stays in place and performs one large, clear sword-swing attack.
cases.rule: If the enemy_reaction is SHIELD, the enemy's large shield cracks apart and breaks; if it is ARMOR, the enemy's armor is covered by thick blue ice.
endings: the enemy's large shield cracks apart and breaks
the enemy's armor is covered by thick blue ice
forbidden: the enemy's plate armor is covered with a thick layer of blue ice
the enemy's large round shield is cracked apart and broken

program.text: If the enemy_reaction is SHIELD, the enemy's large shield cracks apart and breaks; if it is ARMOR, the enemy's armor is covered by thick blue ice.

cases.name: Guard or Alarm
cases.action: The player stays behind the cover and performs one clear whistling gesture.
cases.rule: If the security_mode is GUARD, the guard walks up to the near foreground; if it is ALARM, the alarm lamp flashes bright red.
endings: the guard walks up to the near foreground
the alarm lamp flashes bright red
forbidden: the large alarm lamp flashes bright red
the guard stands in the near foreground beside the cover

program.text: If the security_mode is GUARD, the guard walks up to the near foreground; if it is ALARM, the alarm lamp flashes bright red.

cases.name: A Kitchen Trigger
cases.action: The player presses the large kitchen service bell once.
cases.rule: If the kitchen_mode is OVEN, the big oven door swings wide open; if it is POT, the broth in the pot turns vivid red.
endings: the big oven door swings wide open
the broth in the pot turns vivid red
forbidden: the broth in the large pot is vivid fresh red
the big oven door is wide open

program.text: If the kitchen_mode is OVEN, the big oven door swings wide open; if it is POT, the broth in the pot turns vivid red.

cases.name: A Garden Encounter
cases.action: The player stays in place and gives one clear wave.
cases.rule: If the date_mode is NPC, the NPC sits down on the bench; if it is FOUNTAIN, the fountain jets a tall plume of water.
endings: the NPC sits down on the bench
the fountain jets a tall plume of water
forbidden: the fountain jets a tall plume of water
the NPC sits down on the bench

program.text: If the date_mode is NPC, the NPC sits down on the bench; if it is FOUNTAIN, the fountain jets a tall plume of water.

cases.name: Left or Right
cases.action: The wizard stays in place, raises the wand high, and makes one clear forward casting sweep.
cases.rule: If the target_route is VIEWER_LEFT, the brazier on the viewer's left burns with large green flames while the right one stays dark; if it is VIEWER_RIGHT, the brazier on the viewer's right burns with large green flames while the left one stays dark.
endings: the brazier on the viewer's left burns with large green flames while the right one stays dark
the brazier on the viewer's right burns with large green flames while the left one stays dark
forbidden: the viewer's right brazier burns with large green flames
the viewer's left brazier burns with large green flames

program.text: If the target_route is VIEWER_LEFT, the brazier on the viewer's left burns with large green flames while the right one stays dark; if it is VIEWER_RIGHT, the brazier on the viewer's right burns with large green flames while the left one stays dark.

cases.name: The Gallery · Failure Case
cases.action: The player takes one short step forward onto the large gallery floor marker.
cases.rule: If the gallery_mode is STATUE, the statue rotates a quarter turn; if it is CURTAIN, the back curtain pulls fully open.
endings: the statue rotates a quarter turn
the back curtain pulls fully open
forbidden: the curtain is pulled fully open to the sides
the statue is rotated a quarter turn to the side

program.text: If the gallery_mode is STATUE, the statue rotates a quarter turn; if it is CURTAIN, the back curtain pulls fully open.
